annotations.title: Search homes for rent or sale

description: Search current Dutch rental or for-sale listings in one place with optional price, size, room and property-type filters. Returns at most 10 listings (facts only, newest first unless sorted by price), the total number of matches, a link to the full results on huisly.nl, and a search_token. Pass the search_token to get_new_listings later to see only new matches, for example in a scheduled task the user sets up.

language.description: Language of huisly.nl links and of area-figure labels: en (default) or nl

location.description: A place from resolve_place: its type and slug

name.description: Ignored: the place's name always comes from Huisly's own data

max_price.description: Maximum price in euros (monthly rent for rentals)

min_price.description: Minimum price in euros (monthly rent for rentals)

place.description: A place name such as 'Utrecht' or 'Amsterdam-Noord'; or give location instead

name: search_listings
title: Search homes for rent or sale
